scenario.title: Everything goes wrong (real run, Gemini, final code)
scenario.description: A real run planned by gemini-3.5-flash-lite at the final code: rate limits, a timeout after a write that landed, and the target API changing version mid-run. The independent verifier re-reads the first batch of each mapping, then everything at the end.

fault_plan.note: recorded run; the fault plan is in scenarios/scenarios.yaml
